title: Luxurious Cabin and Substantial Feel
summary: The sampled feedback centers on the G60’s luxurious cabin, upscale look, smooth drive, and substantial feel, though most excerpts are descriptive rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the quiet luxurious cabin, smooth driving character, attractive appearance, and power.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts describe the vehicle as more luxurious, substantial, sporty-looking, and comfortable, but the examples are too brief to confirm clear sentiment beyond those descriptors.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are very short descriptive phrases, which limits confidence in interpreting sentiment beyond the stated wording.
The undetermined examples dominate the sample, so the topic summary should not be read as a strong sentiment conclusion.
The sample is small and stratified, so it is not a representative estimate of all G60 feedback on this topic.
